LanguageData.CC_Clock_Pass_RareGodPresence: A god's own presence on the land
LanguageData.CC_GodPO_Num_WarmerRock: {DEG} warmer out of doors, and warmer still in the rooms under the rock.
LanguageData.CC_GodPO_Num_Beasts: No animal on the land turns on anyone.
LanguageData.CC_GodPO_Num_Peace: Insults are {PCT} rarer, and fights {FIGHTS} rarer.
LanguageData.CC_GodPO_Num_Rot: Food left out of the cold, and the dead, rot {PCT} faster.
LanguageData.CC_GodPO_Num_Hearths: Hearths and fires burn longer and give more heat.
LanguageData.CC_GodPO_Num_Batteries: Batteries keep {PCT} of what they give out.
LanguageData.CC_GodPO_Num_Benches: Work at powered benches goes {PCT} faster.
LanguageData.CC_GodPO_Num_WeatherHolds: The weather holds as it is.
LanguageData.CC_GodPO_Num_Gaze: Looking up at the sky is twice as likely, and {PCT} more enjoyable.
LanguageData.CC_GodPO_Num_ColdSooner: The old, the sick and babies feel the cold {DEG} sooner.
LanguageData.CC_GodPO_Num_LightHeld: The light of the hour holds.
LanguageData.CC_GodPO_Num_MoonNight: The night is as light as the moon's face is full.
LanguageData.CC_GodPO_Num_Wet: Plants on wet ground grow {PCT} faster.
LanguageData.CC_GodPO_Num_Wells: Nobody falls sick from bad water.
LanguageData.CC_GodPO_Saw_WarmVoice: {WHO} slept under the mountain at {HOME} and woke saying a warm voice had spoken in the dark.
LanguageData.CC_GodPO_Saw_TrueDream: {WHO} woke under the full moon at {HOME} and told a dream: "{DREAM}"
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_ThrumbosFace: {WHO} saw every thrumbo on the land around {HOME} stop and stand facing the same way.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_GrassBowed: {WHO} saw the grass at {HOME} bowed flat in one long line, as if something huge had walked there.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Hoofprint: {WHO} found a hoofprint the size of a table at {HOME} one dawn.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Knock: {WHO} heard a knock at the door at {HOME} at dusk, and nobody was there.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_Footprints: {WHO} found footprints up to the door at {HOME} one dawn, and none going away.
LanguageData.CC_GodM_Saw_DogsSilent: {WHO} saw the dogs at {HOME} go quiet all at once and stand facing the gate.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Taken_Way_Sapling_Felt: The offering at {SHRINE} sank into the soil in the night: {WHAT}. A young {EXTRA} stands where it lay.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Taken_Way_Sapling_Plain: The offering at {SHRINE} sank into the soil before everyone's eyes, and a young {EXTRA} came up where it lay: {WHAT}.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Taken_Way_Sapling_Bare: The offering at {SHRINE} sank into the ground: {WHAT}. The soil there is dark and freshly turned.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Taken_Way_Crack_Felt: The offering at {SHRINE} is gone down a crack in the rock beside it: {WHAT}. The floor there is warm.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Taken_Way_Crack_Plain: The offering at {SHRINE} slid down a crack in the rock before everyone's eyes, and warm air came up after it: {WHAT}.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Taken_Way_Grazed_Felt: The offering at {SHRINE} was grazed away in the night: {WHAT}. Beside the place there is a hoofprint the size of a plate.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Taken_Way_Grazed_Plain: Something nobody could see grazed the offering at {SHRINE} away before everyone's eyes and left a great hoofprint: {WHAT}.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Taken_Way_Rot_Felt: The offering at {SHRINE} rotted away overnight into black soil: {WHAT}.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Taken_Way_Rot_Plain: The offering at {SHRINE} went soft and sank into black soil before everyone's eyes: {WHAT}.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Taken_Way_Guest_Felt: The offering at {SHRINE} was gone by morning: {WHAT}. Footprints come up to it from the edge of the land, and none go away.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Taken_Way_Guest_Plain: The offering at {SHRINE} was gone in a breath, and footprints came up to it out of nowhere: {WHAT}.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Taken_Way_Mended_Felt: The part left at {SHRINE} is gone: {WHAT}. The {EXTRA} that had broken down is working again.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Taken_Way_Mended_None: The part left at {SHRINE} is gone: {WHAT}. A light nearby winked three times.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Taken_Way_Mended_Plain: The part left at {SHRINE} went in a spark before everyone's eyes: {WHAT}.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Taken_Way_TakenUp_Felt: In the night a streak of light went up from {SHRINE}, and the offering was gone: {WHAT}.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Taken_Way_TakenUp_Plain: The offering at {SHRINE} rose into the night sky in a streak of light, before everyone's eyes: {WHAT}.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Taken_Way_Frost_Felt: The offering at {SHRINE} frosted over in the night and was gone at dawn, the frost still lying where it was: {WHAT}.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Taken_Way_Frost_Plain: The offering at {SHRINE} frosted white before everyone's eyes and was gone: {WHAT}.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Taken_Way_Hunger_Felt: The offering at {SHRINE} was gone by morning: {WHAT}, and with it {EXTRA} from the stores beside it.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Taken_Way_Hunger_Only: The offering at {SHRINE} was gone by morning: {WHAT}. The place is cold to stand near.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Taken_Way_Hunger_Plain: The offering at {SHRINE} went into the dark before everyone's eyes: {WHAT}.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Taken_Way_Never_Returned: The offering at {SHRINE} lay in the noon light all day, and at dusk it was still there: {WHAT}.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Taken_Way_Moon_Felt: The offering at {SHRINE} was gone under the moon, and the place shone silver a while: {WHAT}.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Taken_Way_Moon_Plain: The offering at {SHRINE} went up in the moonlight before everyone's eyes: {WHAT}.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Taken_Way_Moon_Returned: The offering at {SHRINE} waited out a week of nights with no moon, and went back to the stores: {WHAT}.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Taken_Way_Well_Felt: The offering at {SHRINE} is gone: {WHAT}. Something croaked deep down in the water when it went.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Taken_Way_Well_Plain: The offering at {SHRINE} was gone in a splash before everyone's eyes, and something croaked deep in the water: {WHAT}.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Taken_Way_Given_Seen: The offering at {SHRINE} went to {EXTRA} of {FACTION}, to carry on with them: {WHAT}.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Taken_Way_Given_Plain: The offering at {SHRINE} went to {EXTRA} of {FACTION} before everyone's eyes, in a glint of gold: {WHAT}.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Taken_Way_Cat_Seen: At dawn a cat came to {SHRINE} and ate the offering where it lay: {WHAT}.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Taken_Way_Cat_Felt: The offering at {SHRINE} was gone at dawn, and there were paw prints where it had lain: {WHAT}.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Taken_Way_Cat_Plain: The offering at {SHRINE} was gone in a breath before everyone's eyes, and paw prints were left where it had lain: {WHAT}.
